name: Namco Chronicle
summary:
Namco Chronicle is a tactical role-playing game originally developed for Japanese feature phones. The game brings together heroes and heroines from classic Namco franchises in a crossover adventure.

The story is divided into three chapters: Fantasy, City, and Space. Players recruit familiar Namco characters, engage in turn-based tactical battles, and experience story-driven adventure sequences between missions. Featured characters include Valkyrie, Gil, Ki, Wonder Momo, and other iconic Namco heroes.
